claim_text: If a Content Security Policy omits script-src, default-src can act as the fallback directive for external script fetches.
evidence_text: The default-src directive serves as a fallback for fetch directives that are not explicitly set. If script-src is not specified, default-src supplies the policy for script resource requests.
verification_rationale: The evidence explicitly identifies default-src as the fallback for unspecified fetch directives and names script resource requests when script-src is absent. This supports the claim about external script fetches.
